- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Appendix I: Personal Reflections and Journal Prompts includes questions and prompts to guide self-reflection and processing of grief.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A list of journal prompts including:
  1. Write a letter to your loved one.
  2. Describe a comforting memory.
  3. Reflect on the stages of grief experienced.
  4. Consider how faith has been affected by grief.
  5. List five things you are grateful for.
  6. Describe new rituals created to honor your loved one.
  7. Write about personal growth from the grief journey.
  8. Reflect on your support system.
  9. Identify helpful self-care activities.
  10. Write about moments of peace or acceptance in grief.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is no right or wrong way to use the journal prompts; they are meant to help process emotions and gain insight into the grief journey.
